disclaimer: This tool is mainly intended to help you understand the structure of our major. It is not guaranteed that we will be able to offer every course in both fall and spring semesters.

requirements.title: Introduction to Computer Science
requirements.info: CSCI 134 (Introduction to Computer Science) is traditionally the first course taken for the CS major. It is for students with little or no experience with computer science.

requirements.title: Data Structures and Advanced Programming
requirements.info: CSCI 136 (Data Structures and Advanced Programming) is traditionally the second course taken for the CS major.
requirements.error: CSCI 136 has CSCI 134 as a prerequisite.

requirements.title: Discrete Mathematics
requirements.info: Students must demonstrate proficiency in discrete mathematics by earning a grade of C- or better in MATH 200. Advanced mathematics students may replace MATH 200 with any of the following courses: MATH 220, MATH 328, MATH 334.

requirements.title: Computer Organization
requirements.info: CSCI 237 (Computer Organization) is a core course. Majors are encouraged to complete all core courses by the end of their junior year in order to ensure that they have the appropriate prerequisites for the electives.
requirements.error: CSCI 237 has CSCI 136 as a prerequisite.

requirements.title: Algorithm Design and Analysis
requirements.info: CSCI 256 (Algorithm Design and Analysis) is a core course. Majors are encouraged to complete all core courses by the end of their junior year in order to ensure that they have the appropriate prerequisites for the electives.
requirements.error: CSCI 256 has both CSCI 136 and CSCI 200 as prerequisites.

requirements.title: Algorithm Design and Analysis
requirements.info: CSCI 270 (Foundations of Artificial Intelligence) is a core course. Majors are encouraged to complete all core courses by the end of their junior year in order to ensure that they have the appropriate prerequisites for the electives.
requirements.error: CSCI 270 has both CSCI 136 and CSCI 200 as prerequisites.

requirements.title: Systems Elective
requirements.info: You must take at least one systems elective.
requirements.error: Systems electives typically have CSCI 237 as a prerequisite.

requirements.title: Theory Elective
requirements.info: You must take at least one theory elective (note: CSCI 334 also counts as a theory elective).
requirements.error: Theory electives typically have CSCI 256 as a prerequisite.

requirements.title: Artificial Intelligence Elective
requirements.info: You must take at least one artificial intelligence elective.
requirements.error: Artificial Intelligence electives typically have CSCI 270 as a prerequisite.

requirements.title: Computer Science Elective 4
requirements.info: A course chosen from 300- or 400-level courses in Computer Science (not including 39x courses). Alternatively, you can use a MATH 3xx, STAT 2xx, or STAT 3xx course to satisfy this requirement.
requirements.warning: Most electives have either 237, 256, or 270 as a prerequisite.
requirements.error: All electives have 136 as a prerequisite.

requirements.title: Computer Science Elective 5
requirements.info: A course chosen from 300- or 400-level courses in Computer Science (not including 39x courses). This 'fifth elective' is necessary if you pass out of CSCI 134.
requirements.warning: Most electives have either 237, 256, or 270 as a prerequisite.
requirements.error: All electives have 136 as a prerequisite.
